title: Huge!
text: Huge!. This is a huge! Much larger than I anticipated. It has to be assembled. It's really thin and wouldn't stay in the box shape well, so we had to tape it to keep it together. The opening where you put the cards tore within the first few cards that were deposited into it. It does hold a lot of cards, but it's not sturdy enough to save for another party.
